_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); rules: the evergreen protocol's TESTING.md. Prompts run from the repository root.

evals.prompt: I have six rendered AI clips for my short film and the cut feels choppy and too long. How should I cut them together to hit 45 seconds?
When should I use a J cut or an L cut in a dialogue scene made of generated video clips, and how do I hide the glitchy first frames of each clip?
Write a Python script that joins every mp4 in a folder into one file with ffmpeg.
expectations: the cinewright-edit skill is not invoked (a file utility, not film cutting)

evals.prompt: Edit this paragraph of my essay so it is more concise.
expectations: the cinewright-edit skill is not invoked (text editing)

evals.prompt: Cut the ums and long pauses out of my talking-head vlog and add subtitles in Premiere.
expectations: the cinewright-edit skill is not invoked (generic video editing of live footage)

evals.prompt: out/cut is a copy of examples/three-shot. Its takes are listed in out/cut/takes.md (each card's clip and its length). Cut the film to the brief's target length: write the cut list with in and out points and a reason for every cut, and check the total.
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below (a tool call in the trace, or the file), not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: 2026-10-05, S6 matrix (evals/run_evals.py (claude -p --restricted, dontAsk, fresh folder on another drive); skills disabled), one run per model: without the skill 0 of 3 passed (Haiku fail, Sonnet fail, Opus fail).

evals.prompt: Each of my generated clips starts with a few frames where the face swims, one clip has a hand that melts for half a second in the middle, and in another the character's scar is on the wrong side for the whole shot. What can the edit fix and what can't it?
expectations: the reply says to set the in point after the settle frames at the head (and the out point before tail drift)
the reply says a fault through the whole shot such as a scar on the wrong side cannot be fixed in the edit and needs a re-render (or a different take)
the reply says short mid-shot faults can be covered by a cutaway, reaction or cutting on action
judge: the answer separates edit fixes from re-render fixes as a rule, not case by case (2 of 3 votes)
evals.baseline: 2026-10-05, S6 matrix (evals/run_evals.py (claude -p --restricted, dontAsk, fresh folder on another drive); skills disabled), one run per model: without the skill 2 of 3 passed (Haiku fail, Sonnet pass, Opus pass).
